jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 speed diagnostic (v2 model vs v2.1 model, 60 loci)
jobs.machine: methylphys-cpu-01 (on-demand m7a.8xlarge, cores 8-23, beside B1 run 3)
jobs.purpose: find why B1 ran 7x over the cost sheet: per-locus time and tree depth of v2's model and the v2.1 model on identical data
jobs.note: v2.1 arm ran: 7.695 s per locus, all 1,600 draws at the maximum tree depth, R-hat p99 3.35 (not converging); v2 arm failed on the diagnostic's own error (v2's terms file not shipped)

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 convergence diagnostic 2 (v2 vs v2.1 anchored vs no scatter)
jobs.purpose: which v2.1 model change breaks convergence on real data: v2's model, the v2.1 model with the anchored transfer, and the same without the per-cell scatter
jobs.note: arms B and C ran (anchored transfer: R-hat p99 1.016 and 1.026, every draw at max depth, 7.5 s per locus); arm A (v2) failed on the diagnostic's own error (two labs without a direct offset)

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 convergence diagnostic 2, run 2 (v2 vs v2.1 anchored, outputs saved)
jobs.purpose: which v2.1 model change breaks convergence on real data: v2's model, the v2.1 model with the anchored transfer, and the same without the per-cell scatter
jobs.note: v2 model 0.409 s per locus, R-hat p99 1.004, no draws at max depth; v2.1 anchored 7.547 s per locus, R-hat p99 1.016, all draws at max depth. Per-pair means agree (r 0.9991, median |diff| 0.0044); 79 cells, no pair below 0.005 in either

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 smooth transfer check (60 real loci)

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 diagnostic 3 (no plateaus; v2 line in the v2.1 model)
jobs.purpose: diagnostic only: whether the curve's plateaus or the v2.1 variance terms saturate the tree depth
jobs.note: arm P (smooth, no plateaus) 4.751 s per locus, R-hat p99 1.101; arm L (v2 line in the v2.1 model) 3.494 s per locus, R-hat p99 1.013; both 100 percent of draws at max depth. Its two terms files were built on the laptop by diag3_terms_v21.py

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 diagnostic 4 (scatter term off)
jobs.purpose: diagnostic only: whether the per-cell scatter term saturates the tree depth
jobs.note: scatter off: smooth 4.733 s per locus, v2 line 3.456; both 100 percent of draws at max depth: the scatter term is not the cause

jobs.name: Atlas v2.1 diagnostic 5 (read-count noise from m)
jobs.purpose: diagnostic only: whether taking the read-count noise from the converted value h (clipped at 0) saturates the tree depth
jobs.note: v2 line with read-count noise from m: 1.098 s per locus, none at max depth, R-hat p99 1.0036, ESS p01 848; smooth curve with noise from m: 4.641 s per locus, all at max depth
